aliados.meta.title: Our Partners
aliados.meta.desc: Meet the companies and institutions powering UAMOTORS. Discover the benefits of sponsoring our project and accelerating UAM engineering talent.
aliados.main.title: Our Partners
aliados.intro.text: UAMOTORS is an initiative that seeks to demonstrate the high caliber of UAM in global technological arenas. To realize our vision and push Mexican engineering to the limit, we seek strategic partners to provide the technical and financial support necessary to turn this development into a competitive reality.
aliados.card1.title: Strategic Partnership
aliados.card1.text: We do not seek merely a sponsor, but a strategic partner to drive student talent growth and strengthen technological development in Mexico.
aliados.card2.title: Academy-Industry Link
aliados.card2.text: The project positions companies as champions of young talent, providing a direct connection platform with the UAM university community.
aliados.beneficios.title: Key Benefits
aliados.beneficio1.title: Brand Visibility:
aliados.beneficio1.text: Logo placement on our race car "OP", uniforms, and promotional material.
aliados.beneficio2.title: Digital Impact:
aliados.beneficio2.text: Continuous presence on our social platforms with a dynamic, growing reach.
aliados.beneficio3.title: Tax Benefit:
aliados.beneficio3.text: Tax-deductible receipts provided with the support of Fundación UAM.
aliados.beneficio4.title: Event Presence:
aliados.beneficio4.text: Brand exposure at university community events and team exhibitions.
aliados.cta.title: Accelerate Our Goal!
aliados.cta.text: Your support is the engine that drives UAM engineering to the next level. To learn about our collaboration models and their benefits, get in touch and let's work together.
aliados.notice1: Benefit applicable exclusively to entities with tax residence in Mexico.
aliados.notice2: Availability, size, and placement of logos on the race car, uniforms, and events, as well as the frequency of digital mentions, are subject to the selected sponsorship tier and the team's production cutoff dates.
